14bd157cfa5e.title_issue: 용출 이상 조사 지연·공정 관리 미흡
14bd157cfa5e.hook_line: 새 공급업체 첨가제로 용출이 떨어진 것을 보고도 기준일탈 뒤에야 조사
14bd157cfa5e.summary: FDA가 인도 완제의약품 제조소 Alkem Laboratories Limited에 경고서한을 발행했다. 용출 이상과 불만 조사 미흡, 과학적 근거 없는 공정 변수 설정, 설비 세척·유지 관리 미흡 등 위반 3건을 지적했다.
key_facts: 위반 1: 2021년 타당성 연구에서 새 공급업체 첨가제로 용출 속도가 떨어진 것을 보고도 2025년 3월 기준일탈(OOS) 결과가 나온 뒤에야 조사를 시작함(21 CFR 211.192)
위반 2: 정제 공정이 관리 상태에 있지 않고 2021년 이후 여러 배치가 용출 규격에 맞지 않아 불합격·회수됨(21 CFR 211.100(a))
위반 3: 2024년 1월~2026년 4월 손상돼 폐기한 기계 부품의 제품 영향을 평가하는 체계가 없었고, 2026-03-27 세척·보관한 설비에서 2026-04-20 녹 모양 변색이 발견됨(21 CFR 211.67(b))
당국 조치: 15영업일 안에 서면 회신, 자격 있는 컨설턴트 고용 권고, 위반 해소 전 신규 허가 보류 가능
14bd157cfa5e.implication: 회사는 해당 배치가 2025년 8월 6개월 안정성 시점에야 기준일탈 기준에 이르렀고 새 공급업체 원료 특성 평가는 절차서가 요구하지 않았다고 회신했다. FDA는 관련 품질 경향을 찾고 조사하지 못한 체계적 실패를 설명하지 못한다며 회신을 받아들이지 않았다(위반 1). 2025년 9월 이후 깨지고 젖은 정제 불만이 약 38건 접수됐고 시정 및 예방조치(CAPA) 시행 뒤에도 불만이 이어졌다(위반 1). 회사는 공정 변수 규격을 과학적 연구가 아닌 과거 추세 자료로 정했다고 인정했다(위반 2). 회사는 해당 정제의 미국용 생산을 일시 중단하겠다고 약속했다.
checks: 새 공급업체 원료를 도입할 때 완제품 용출 영향을 평가하는가? (위반 1)
핵심 공정 변수의 범위를 과학적 연구 자료로 뒷받침하는가? (위반 2)
손상된 설비 부품을 폐기할 때 그 부품으로 만든 제품 영향을 평가하는가? (위반 3)

en.hook_line: Lower dissolution with new supplier excipients went uninvestigated until results failed
en.summary: FDA issued a warning letter to Indian finished pharmaceuticals manufacturer Alkem Laboratories Limited, citing three violations: deficient investigations of dissolution results and complaints, process parameters without scientific justification, and inadequate equipment cleaning and maintenance.
key_facts: Violation 1: a 2021 feasibility study showed lower dissolution with excipients from new suppliers, but no investigation began until OOS dissolution results in March 2025 (21 CFR 211.192)
Violation 2: the tablet manufacturing process is not in a state of control, and since 2021 multiple batches failed dissolution and were rejected or recalled (21 CFR 211.100(a))

Violation 3: damaged machine parts removed between January 2024 and April 2026 were not assessed for product impact, and equipment cleaned and stored on March 27, 2026 showed rust-like discoloration on April 20, 2026 (21 CFR 211.67(b))
Agency action: written response within fifteen business days, a qualified consultant recommended, and new approvals may be withheld
en.implication: The firm responded that the batch did not reach the OOS threshold until the six-month stability interval in August 2025 and that its procedure did not require assessing new supplier material attributes. FDA found the response inadequate because it does not account for the systemic failure to identify and investigate related quality trends (Violation 1). About 38 complaints for broken and wet tablets were received since September 2025, and complaints continued after CAPAs were implemented (Violation 1). The firm acknowledged specifications were derived from historical trend data rather than science-based studies (Violation 2). The firm committed to temporarily suspend U.S. production of the tablets.
checks: When introducing components from a new supplier, do you assess the effect on finished product dissolution? (Violation 1)
Are critical process parameter ranges supported by scientific studies? (Violation 2)
When damaged equipment parts are discarded, do you assess impact on products made with them? (Violation 3)

en.title_issue: GMP approval revoked over falsified records
en.hook_line: Sterility tests still running were recorded as complete and products shipped as passing
en.summary: MFDS revoked a manufacturer's GMP compliance approval for cephalosporin products (sterile and non-sterile synthesis) after it manufactured differently from its approval and repeatedly falsified batch and test records.
key_facts: Violation: a cefotetan product was made by mixing post-packaging remnants and materials without batch records into one batch, while batch records were repeatedly falsified as if made per the approval

Violation: for 6 products, sterility tests were still in progress but start and end dates were falsified, and certificates of analysis were marked as passing and products shipped without confirmed results
Sanction: revocation of GMP compliance approval effective December 8, 2026 for cephalosporin products (sterile and non-sterile synthesis)
Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Article 38-3(1) and (3)2, and Article 48-5(2) [Annex 5-2] item 2 of the Enforcement Rule on drug safety
checks: Is release approval blocked until sterility test results are final?
Do you reconcile charged materials so that remnants or materials without batch records cannot enter production?

en.hook_line: Herbal materials failed appearance and cadmium limits, 3-month suspension
en.summary: MFDS suspended a manufacturer's operations for two herbal medicine products for 3 months after both failed quality tests on distributed herbal materials, for appearance and for heavy metals (cadmium).
key_facts: Violation: one herbal product (batch PUJ08625111A) failed the appearance test because the outer bark was not removed
Violation: another herbal product (batch PUJ13225061A) contained cadmium at 0.5ppm against a limit of 0.3ppm or less

Basis: Pharmaceutical Affairs Act Articles 62(11) and 76(1)4, 5-17 and (3), and [Annex 8] II item 39(d)11 of the Enforcement Rule

recall-dfe247bc36de.summary: 알림타액상주25밀리그램/밀리리터(페메트렉시드이나트륨염칠수화물)가 시판 후 안정성 시험(유연물질) 기준 초과 우려로 회수됐다(사전 예방적 영업자 회수).
key_facts: 사유: 시판 후 안정성 시험(유연물질) 기준 초과 우려
제품·범위: 알림타액상주25밀리그램/밀리리터(페메트렉시드이나트륨염칠수화물)
구분: 영업자 회수

en.hook_line: Pemetrexed injection recalled as a precaution after post-marketing stability testing
en.summary: A pemetrexed 25 mg/mL liquid injection was recalled as a precaution because post-marketing stability testing showed related substances could exceed the limit (voluntary recall).
key_facts: Reason: possible excess of related substances in post-marketing stability testing
Product and scope: one pemetrexed 25 mg/mL liquid injection product
Type: voluntary recall

D-0156-2027.hook_line: 셀룰로스 입자로 20,567 vials Class I 회수
D-0156-2027.summary: Brevital Sodium(메토헥시탈 나트륨) 주사용 바이알이 셀룰로스로 확인된 입자 검출로 회수됐다.
key_facts: 사유: 입자 검출 — 셀룰로스로 확인
제품·범위: Brevital Sodium 500 mg/vial 다회용 바이알, 로트 86930·88623, 20,567 vials
등급: Class I
quotes_translation: 입자 이물 존재 — 입자는 셀룰로스로 확인됨

en.hook_line: 20,567 vials of methohexital injection recalled for cellulose particulates, Class I
en.summary: Brevital Sodium (methohexital sodium) for injection vials were recalled after particulate matter identified as cellulose was found.
key_facts: Reason: presence of particulate matter identified as cellulose
Product and scope: Brevital Sodium 500 mg/vial multiple dose vials, lots 86930 and 88623, 20,567 vials
Class: Class I

D-0189-2027.hook_line: 히알루론산 표방 제품에서 덱사메타손 등 미표시 성분 검출, Class I
D-0189-2027.summary: 히알루론산 보충제로 판매된 UMARY Acido Hialuronico가 FDA 시험에서 미표시 성분이 검출돼 회수됐다.
key_facts: 사유: 승인(NDA/ANDA) 없이 판매 — FDA 시험에서 미표시 성분 덱사메타손·디클로페낙·오메프라졸 검출
제품·범위: 유효기간 안의 전 로트, 15 bottles
등급: Class I
quotes_translation: 승인된 NDA/ANDA 없이 판매 — FDA 시험 분석에서 미표시 성분 덱사메타손, 디클로페낙, 오메프라졸이 혼입된 것으로 확인됨

en.hook_line: Hyaluronic acid product tainted with dexamethasone and other undeclared drugs, Class I
en.summary: UMARY Acido Hialuronico, sold as a hyaluronic acid supplement, was recalled after FDA laboratory analysis found undeclared drug ingredients.
key_facts: Reason: marketed without an approved NDA/ANDA; FDA analysis found undeclared dexamethasone, diclofenac and omeprazole
Product and scope: all lots within expiry, 15 bottles
Class: Class I

D-0192-2027.title_issue: 무균성 보증 부족 조제 주사제 회수
D-0192-2027.hook_line: 조제 테스토스테론 주사 바이알, 무균성 보증 부족으로 Class II
D-0192-2027.summary: 조제 의약품인 테스토스테론 시피오네이트/프로피오네이트 주사 바이알이 무균성 보증 부족으로 회수됐다.
key_facts: 사유: 무균성 보증 부족
제품·범위: Testosterone Cypionate / Testosterone Propionate 200/10 mg/mL 30 mL 바이알, Lot 04012026@2
등급: Class II

en.hook_line: Compounded testosterone vials recalled for lack of sterility assurance, Class II
en.summary: Compounded testosterone cypionate and testosterone propionate injection vials were recalled for lack of sterility assurance.
key_facts: Reason: lack of sterility assurance
Product and scope: Testosterone Cypionate / Testosterone Propionate 200/10 mg/mL, 30mL vials, Lot 04012026@2
Class: Class II
